preconditions.description: The number of rows n must be between 1 and 2000.
The number of columns m must be between 1 and 2000.
The starting row index r must be within the range of the number of rows.
The starting column index c must be within the range of the number of columns.
The maximum allowed number of movements to the left x must be non-negative.
The maximum allowed number of movements to the right y must be non-negative.

preconditions.expression: all(len(row) == m for row in labyrinth)
preconditions.description: Each row of the labyrinth must have exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(cell in '.*' for row in labyrinth for cell in row)
preconditions.description: Each cell in the labyrinth must be either '.' or '*'.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of reachable cells from the starting cell.
